summary: Ardagh Metal Packaging S.A. filed a Form 6-K containing its quarterly report for the three and six months ended June 30, 2026. The filing is a routine periodic report of a foreign private issuer, incorporating the interim financials by reference into an existing F-3 registration statement. No special-situation event — such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC event, or management change — is announced. The filing solely fulfills ongoing SEC reporting obligations under the 1934 Act. There are no deal terms to report.
